LightningComponentBundle.description: Provides a dropdown menu to add products to secondary (named) carts, with authentication checks, cart fetching, and toast notifications.

property.name: disabled
property.label: Disabled
property.description: If true, the dropdown button is disabled.

property.name: productId
property.label: Product ID
property.description: The ID of the product to add to the secondary cart.

property.name: quantity
property.label: Quantity
property.description: The quantity of the product to add.

property.name: productName
property.label: Product Name
property.description: The name of the product to add (used in toast messages).

property.name: showItemCount
property.label: Show Item Count
property.description: Show the number of items in each cart.

property.name: countType
property.label: Shows the total quantity or the number of unique products in the cart.
